# Carol Stream/ Winfield

## Doctors of Physical Therapy

### Welcome to DPT - Carol Stream!

At our Carol Stream physical therapy clinic, we provide compassionate, evidence-based care. Every patient receives individualized, one-on-one treatment from an expert clinician. Whether you’re recovering from injury or surgery or simply addressing a longtime ache or pain that keeps you from optimal function, we’re here to help you get better, faster!

We are located at 26W228 Geneva Road in Carol Stream, IL. We’re on the northwest corner of Geneva and Pleasant Hill Road next to CVS and Maciano’s Restaurant.

Our expert team of clinicians can take on any of your needs – we also specialize in dry needling, strength and conditioning, Graston and HawkGrips instrument assisted soft tissue mobilization, blood flow restriction therapy, corrective exercise, performance enhancement, and offer video motion analysis.

We can’t wait to see you!

### Find us Here

26W228 Geneva Rd.

Carol Stream, IL 60188

### Get In touch

Phone: 630-429-9253

Fax: 630-480-0822

### Clinic Hours
